content:
Apple Arcade just added four new games to its library of over 200+ titles, and it has announced five more that will arrive in the coming month.

Here’s what’s new and coming next to Apple Arcade

If you’re looking for a gaming experience free from ads or In-App Purchases, it’s hard to beat Apple Arcade. Many iPhone games are riddled with ads and upsells, but Arcade is entirely ad-free and microtransaction-free.

Apple Arcade is available for $6.99/month and is also included in the Apple One bundle.

The gaming service provides unlimited access to over 200 titles, and just today added four new ones:

Apple has also announced five additional titles that will debut in the month ahead.

On Tuesday, June 30, Family Feud Pocket joins the Arcade library:

Then on Thursday, July 2, four more games will arrive:

  • Dungeon Clawler+: “combines the strategic depth of a roguelike deckbuilder with the unpredictability of an arcade claw machine”
  • Creatures of the Deep+: “single-player fishing adventure that plunges players into a world of ancient secrets, legendary monsters, and mysterious treasures”
  • Pocket City 2+: “fun spin on the city-building genre, allowing players to construct a sprawling metropolis and then drop themselves in it”
  • Draw It+: “challenges artists and doodlers alike to sketch clues from a wide variety of prompts and score points before time runs out.”

If you use Apple TV and/or Apple Music, the best way to get Apple Arcade is with the Apple One bundle, as all bundle tiers include Arcade access.

Are you an Apple Arcade subscriber? What are your favorite titles? Let us know in the comments.
